description: We are a team passionate about technology, artificial intelligence and space exploration! 🚀
summary:
Mikrokosmos is an interactive educational game that puts children aged 7-12 in charge of a lunar base, challenging them to think and make decisions like real astronauts.

Inspired by swipe-based decision games, players navigate a series of story-driven scenarios where every choice has consequences. They must balance limited resources, protect their crew from radiation, maintain life support and communications, and advance scientific research while responding to unexpected challenges.



Our mission: inspire the next generation of space explorers by showing them that every great mission begins with a decision!
details:
How Does It Work?

Mikrokosmos is an interactive educational game where children aged 7-12 become commanders of Aurora, a fictional lunar base near the Moon's south pole.

Through a swipe-based card interface, players make decisions that influence their mission across six Earth days. They can follow three narrative paths: Preparation, Geology and Shadows, each presenting different challenges and opportunities.

Players must balance four key indicators:

  • Life Support
  • Radiation Shielding
  • Science
  • Communications

While managing limited energy, oxygen and food reserves.

Educational Value and Innovation

Unlike traditional quizzes, Mikrokosmos combines branching storytelling with resource management and meaningful decision-making.

Players learn about the challenges of lunar exploration while developing critical thinking, problem-solving and systems thinking skills.

The game encourages experimentation, showing children that mistakes are opportunities to learn and that different decisions can lead to different mission outcomes.

Our goal is to inspire curiosity about space exploration and STEM through an engaging, accessible experience.

Technologies Used

Mikrokosmos was developed using React, TypeScript and Vite, with a custom deterministic simulation engine that separates game logic, narrative content and presentation.

The project uses Vitest and Playwright for automated testing, alongside ESLint and Prettier for code quality.

Vercel is the selected deployment platform.

The application runs entirely in the browser without requiring a backend, database, or user authentication.

Scientific Foundation and Design

The story draws inspiration from real lunar exploration challenges, including radiation protection, energy limitations, life support and scientific research.

The project also incorporates historical context from NASA's DONKI solar activity records into its narrative design, with integration into gameplay planned.

🔗 https://api.nasa.gov/DONKI/SEP?startDate=2024-05-10&endDate=2024-05-12&api_key=DEMO_KEY

We prioritized age-appropriate storytelling, intuitive interactions, accessibility and meaningful consequences.

🚀Mikrokosmos🪐 aims to make space exploration understandable, interactive and exciting, empowering young learners to think like astronauts and discover how every decision shapes a mission.
